about: Note file octave error by typical note: for each one-semitone bin of the note file's typical note (MIDI, as stored), [songs, songs whose note file is an octave or more above the recording]. 4,760 songs with a note file and a recording that is not mostly rap, from scripts/octave-pairs.py and scripts/octave-measure.ts (10 Nov 2026). tests/songs/octave.test.ts keeps TYPICAL_HIGH between the bins.
